text:
Ravi (Sales): ACME asked if we can temporarily shrink their Dedicated POC pool ded-poc-acme-88 for a customer demo to reduce spend. Current commit min_capacity=26, burst_window=2h. They want min_capacity=9, burst_window=20m for the demo only and a short-lived API key bound to their office IPs. Need a YES/NO and estimated lead time by EOD.

Zoe (Infra): We cannot change the committed reservation without 24h notice, but we can place a temporary quota overlay that presents a lower operational min_capacity and attach short-lived burst credits. Caveat: any usage above the commit will be billed as overage. We also support scoped API keys with TTL + IP allowlist.

maria-acme (ACME): We accept potential overage for the demo. Office IPs: 198.51.100.128/25. Key TTL desired: 36h. Demo is tomorrow morning.

Ben (Eng): Quick config I'd apply to the pool overlay:
```json
{"min_capacity":"9","burst_window":"20m","cooldown":"10m","overlay_burst_credits":"60","fallback":"hosted-small"}
```
Add alerting: sustained >80% for 4m -> page on-call.

ops-bot: [automated] Change request logged: POC-7420. Status: awaiting-sales-approval.

Ravi (Sales): Sales approves the overlay and the billing exposure for the demo only. Maria, confirm TTL=36h for key?

maria-acme (ACME): Confirmed TTL=36h and IP range ok. Please proceed.

Zoe (Infra): Plan:
1) Create API key name `acme-demo-88-key` TTL=36h, bind to 198.51.100.128/25.
2) Apply quota overlay to ded-poc-acme-88 at T-2h before demo and attach 60 burst credits.
3) Configure routing fallback to hosted-small with tail-latency threshold 250ms.
4) Post a short runbook and rollback snippet in the ticket. Ops estimate: 50 minutes.

Ben (Eng): Rollback snippet for on-call:
```bash
curl -X PATCH https://api.redwood.ai/dedicated/pools/ded-poc-acme-88 \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"min_capacity":26,"burst_window":"2h","cooldown":"30m"}'
```

ops-bot: [automated] POC-7420 status -> scheduled. Change window: 2026-09-18T14:00:00Z -> 2026-09-18T15:30:00Z.

Zoe (Infra): I will apply the overlay at T-2h and post updates here.

Ravi (Sales): Thanks team, I will confirm the final demo time with ACME. :thumbsup:

maria-acme (ACME): Many thanks! Looking forward to the demo.
